build_GFL_detector: build a GFL single-stage detector instance with backbone, neck, and bbox_head config
run_GFL_loss: run the GFL detector loss computation on a batch of input images and data samples
run_GFL_predict: run the GFL detector predict method to get bounding box predictions from input images
run_GFL_extract_feat: run the GFL detector extract_feat method to get multi-level features from input images
review_GFL_init: review the GFL detector __init__ to understand backbone, neck, and bbox_head initialization
